description: A list of numbers unified with a tuple of strings converts its elements to strings
notes: hashicorp/hcl unifies the tuple's element types as a list first, then unifies that list type with the list of numbers, which gives a list of strings (unifyTuplesAsList in cty/convert/unify.go). The spec unifies a list and a tuple to the tuple type, a tuple of one string. Either way the selected list's first element becomes the string "1".
